title: Ashwagandha for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Ashwagandha for Hair: Topical Trial, Stress & Liver Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What a placebo-controlled trial of a topical ashwagandha serum, stress research and a liver-injury review say about ashwagandha and hair.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; old title 'The Key to Stimulating Hair Growth' dropped; redirected posts unsourced.
flags: Safety: includes liver-injury scoping review with a transplant and deaths among cirrhosis patients; stated plainly.
Yerram trial is one small topical formulation; its abstract's wording 'safer alternative for alopecia' was not repeated.
'Stop and seek care if jaundice, itching' follows the review's described presentation.
